title: cloudbeaver
description: Chart-owned CloudBeaver Community Edition deployment, protected by an external oauth2-proxy auth boundary. This is the authoritative schema for this subchart's own values.

global.description: Auto-propagated by Helm from the umbrella chart's own global values (e.g. global.identity, global.imagePullSecrets). Not owned or validated by this subchart.

serverName.description: Sent as CB_SERVER_NAME on every boot. Must not be empty -- required alongside seed.admin for CloudBeaver's env-var-driven auto-configuration to run at all.

strategy.description: Passed through verbatim as the Deployment's own strategy field -- matches the Kubernetes DeploymentStrategy shape, not validated further here.

auth.description: Live, continuously-reconciled auth provider configuration -- re-applied on every pod start. auth.proxy is the SSO login path (Keycloak via oauth2-proxy) and stays mandatory whenever cloudbeaver.enabled=true (enforced in the umbrella chart's identity-validation.yaml). auth.local is the local/break-glass login path. Both can be registered at once.

seed.description: One-time, first-boot-only provisioning (or after seed.force resets the workspace): seed.admin provisions the native admin identity, seed.teams provisions initial teams/permissions, seed.connections provisions Trino/DB connections and who can use them.

force.description: Wipes the entire workspace on pod start, making every seed below (and h2FreshSchemaPatch) apply as if this were a brand-new install.

admin.description: Native CloudBeaver admin identity. Always provisioned; only actually applied on first boot of a fresh workspace.

teams.description: Seeds CloudBeaver's initial-data.conf teams list. Only applied on first-ever schema creation.

permissions.description: Grants team access to seeded connections -- CloudBeaver's own data-sources-permissions.json. Unlike the rest of seed.*, re-read and fully reconciled on every pod start, not one-time.

config.description: Passed through verbatim into CloudBeaver's own app: {} config (cloudbeaver.runtime.conf). Any key CloudBeaver supports is valid here -- not enumerated/validated by this schema.

extraEnv.description: Raw Kubernetes EnvVar entries appended to the cloudbeaver container.
